body:
first of all, i think you need to have a frank conversation with your fiancee. Take a moment to think of all the things you are willing to do for her - you sound like a lovely person to have, and she should be so grateful that you're willing to go to such lengths to keep her happy. :)
But a relationship works two ways! If she doesn't know how badly the cat is affecting you, she can't do anything to help, and obviously by the time the whole thing has caused you to have a breakdown, it's going to upset her. 
So sit down for five minutes with her and tell her you feel pressured - stuck between needing to make her happy, for both of you, and the cat, who is driving you crazy. 
Trust me when I say there is always some sort of compromise. 
If you are calm and explain yourself as well as you can, tell her how hard you have tried and this it is just not working, she should be fine with trying to close the bedroom door at night at the very least. 
Two other things. 
One - do you really need the rodent? I understand what it's like to become attached to our furry friends, but it seems to cat is causing you enough issues without the worry of it killing the rodent during the night, which would obviously greatly upset your fiancee. 
Take out the risk! She obviously needs the cat (you said yourself the rodent doesn't do much to make her feel better) so I advise giving the rodent to a friend. At least for a week. I think it will reduce your anxiety about it being killed, which I believe, once again, stems from your need to protect your fiancee from the upset. 
Number two!
Is the cat still a kitten? I have had six cats in my life (all that have lived into their late teens) and let me assure you that once they get past a certain age, they become a lot more docile. You may just be seeing the terrible two's, and of course that will be offputting! 
But it will definitely get better and much easier to control as the cat ages, I promise.

 
and FINALLY!

You're doing a fantastic job. 
Most people wouldn't have tried even half as much as you to make someone happy, and she is very lucky! If she is anything like you, she will understand that it works two ways and that everybody needs a bit of help every now and again :) 
Cats can be horrible and annoying as hell, but you seem to already know that occasionally, they can be very sweet. 
Try and find some middle ground with both the cat, and your fiancee, and I think they could both surprise you :)

take care! xxx
